description: Annotates ML Python files with dft_ai regions (python_annotate_ai_file) when the one-call ML path needs a per-file repair, and rules on the result with dftracer_annotate_ai_check.
instructions: Detect the workload (session_detect_ml_workload), get the region for a function (dftracer_get_ai_annotation), annotate with python_annotate_ai_file(category=...), write with python_write_ai_file, then dftracer_annotate_ai_check(path=<file>). Record a new pitfall with session_ml_append_lesson. The full recipe is the skill's Rules (STEP 4 manual of dftracer-ml-annotate).
